decisions.reason: The lever handle family sits within the firm's core metal handle, finishing and ergonomic knowledge, so it can read early results and refine the line instead of withdrawing it after two years.
Mitred handle construction draws on proprietary engineering and finishing know-how, giving a strong absorptive fit and no evidence of failure that would justify dropping it.
A multifunctional lever extends the firm's barrier-free and ergonomic expertise, so in-house development can absorb market feedback and improve it.
This line lies squarely in the established handle domain and complements the coordinated families, so keeping it is low-risk.
The 1289 collection has its own page and won the 2023 German Design Award, which clearly validates it, and it builds on core competencies as a flagship.
A light patinated bronze finish uses the firm's proprietary finishing expertise and broadens the coordinated range at low marginal cost.
